verdict.rationale: Sift's current docs explicitly market 'Workflows' as a 'rules automation platform' for real-time, event-triggered decisions (create custom rules like Ban Account or Cancel Order tied to events) — sift-docs-6, sift-docs-7, sift-docs-12. However, community evidence includes the Sift CEO explicitly stating 'we do not have any rules in our product' and criticizing rules engines as prone to being circumvented, favoring pure ML scoring instead (sift-comm-8, sift-comm-9), with a critic noting ML's slower reaction time versus rules engines (sift-comm-10). This creates a direct contradiction between vendor product docs promoting rule-based Workflows and the company's own stated philosophy against rules. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of Workflows' rule-definition UI/logic, and clarity on whether Workflows launched after the no-rules stance was expressed.
